references.text: The author of the Psalms asks God to collect tears in His bottle, emphasizing that God's attention rests on human sorrow and tears.
The image of those who weep while sowing links tears to hope for future joy, paralleling Jesus' sorrow that leads to resurrection.
Jesus weeps over Jerusalem, a direct parallel to John 11:35 where He shows deep emotional pain over loss and human suffering.
Jesus weeps over the city, showing that His tears in John 11:35 are part of a pattern where He shares in human sorrow.
